name: _cudnn_init_dropout_state
description: Representative ATen overload (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim: aten::_cudnn_init_dropout_state(float dropout, bool train, int dropout_seed, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=False) -> Tensor. All supplied registered signatures, copied verbatim: aten::_cudnn_init_dropout_state(float dropout, bool train, int dropout_seed, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=False) -> Tensor ; aten::_cudnn_init_dropout_state.out(float dropout, bool train, int dropout_seed, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). This is one representative registered overload, not an exclusive contract: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract, including overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, so tests must never be removed or narrowed to this single signature. Semantics: _cudnn_init_dropout_state is a cuDNN factory with no tensor input that returns the cuDNN dropout RNG state as a freshly allocated torch.uint8 CUDA tensor; the extent comes from cudnnDropoutGetStatesSize for the active device and the bytes are a pure function of dropout_seed (repeated calls, including from fresh processes, are bit-identical, and different seeds differ), so no tensor shape, value-range, broadcast, special-value or backward grid applies. A valid call requires dropout > 0 (0.0, -0.0, -0.5, nan and -inf are rejected), train=True (train=False maps dropout_p to 0 and then fails the dropout > 0 assert) and dtype=torch.uint8 (dtype=None means float32 and every non-byte dtype is rejected); there is no CPU or Sparse dispatch, so device='cpu', layout=torch.sparse_coo and pin_memory=True are all rejected, and the returned tensor is a new allocation, never a view or alias. The out overload is overload-dependent behavior handled by pytest and is not expressed by this representative overload's effects: it writes into the caller's Tensor(a!) buffer, resizing an empty, differently sized or non-empty buffer to the state size and returning that same buffer, and it rejects a non-uint8 or CPU buffer. Defaults are JSON-representable as supplied (dtype/layout/device default to null and pin_memory defaults to false); no non-JSON ATen default was rendered as a string for this overload.
